title: Detailed football
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Main ball body - bright white sphere -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  
  <!-- Subtle shading for roundness - warm highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='38' rx='28' ry='28' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Shadow on lower right - light grey, not dark -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='none' stroke='#d0d0d0' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Central pentagon - slate blue (reads as dark but lit) -->
  <polygon points='50,28 62,38 58,52 42,52 38,38' fill='#4a4a8a'/>
  
  <!-- Pentagon edges - lighter slate shade for contrast -->
  <polygon points='50,28 62,38 58,52 42,52 38,38' fill='none' stroke='#6a6aaa' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Top left panel - light grey -->
  <polygon points='50,28 38,38 20,30 26,14 42,16' fill='#c8c8d8'/>
  <polygon points='50,28 38,38 20,30 26,14 42,16' fill='none' stroke='#a8a8b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Top right panel - light grey -->
  <polygon points='50,28 62,38 80,30 74,14 58,16' fill='#c8c8d8'/>
  <polygon points='50,28 62,38 80,30 74,14 58,16' fill='none' stroke='#a8a8b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom left panel - light grey -->
  <polygon points='42,52 58,52 66,68 50,80 34,68' fill='#c8c8d8'/>
  <polygon points='42,52 58,52 66,68 50,80 34,68' fill='none' stroke='#a8a8b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Left side panel - light grey -->
  <polygon points='38,38 42,52 34,68 18,60 12,44 20,30' fill='#d8d8e8'/>
  <polygon points='38,38 42,52 34,68 18,60 12,44 20,30' fill='none' stroke='#a8a8b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Right side panel - light grey -->
  <polygon points='62,38 58,52 66,68 82,60 88,44 80,30' fill='#d8d8e8'/>
  <polygon points='62,38 58,52 66,68 82,60 88,44 80,30' fill='none' stroke='#a8a8b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom left outer panel - slightly darker grey -->
  <polygon points='34,68 18,60 12,44 8,50 14,68 22,78' fill='#b8b8c8'/>
  <polygon points='34,68 18,60 12,44 8,50 14,68 22,78' fill='none' stroke='#a0a0b0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom right outer panel - slightly darker grey -->
  <polygon points='66,68 82,60 88,44 92,50 86,68 78,78' fill='#b8b8c8'/>
  <polygon points='66,68 82,60 88,44 92,50 86,68 78,78' fill='none' stroke='#a0a0b0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Top highlight arc -->
  <path d='M 20 30 Q 35 18 50 16 Q 65 18 80 30' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom rim shadow arc - medium grey -->
  <path d='M 22 78 Q 36 88 50 90 Q 64 88 78 78' fill='none' stroke='#b0b0c0' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Small highlight dot -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='30' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
